summary: P1.4a Core profile model — the producer foundation for the in-process flatten (P1.4b follows). The module validateAgainst and renderGuidance currently take stage and path but NOT a profile axis; design section 12.3 requires a context-profile model so the in-process opportunistic path can run a lighter bar. Add the profile axis to the RecipeAuthoringSpec module: a profile parameter (cold-start or opportunistic) on ValidateAgainstOptions and on renderGuidance. The cold-start profile is the CURRENT full-gate behavior and MUST be byte-identical to today (all content gates, the full stage-2 evidence gate including the 3-distinct-files floor and snippet and sourceRef line-format and graph, plus the host-injected session-scope) and it is the DEFAULT, so the already-accepted and re-pointed Plugin stage-1/2 and Core stage-3 consumers that call validateAgainst without a profile are unaffected — re-run the P1 golden-corpus and the stage-3 byte-identical tests to prove zero change. The opportunistic profile (per 12.3) keeps ALL content gates (verb allowlist, the contrast markers with the 4-char rule, markdown floor 200 plus code-or-file-ref, fields and reasoning) AND keeps the cheap grounding (if a sourceRef is given it must carry a line number; if a snippet is given it must match its cited range) but does NOT enforce the 3-distinct-files evidence floor and does NOT run session-scope — this is the DECLARED lighter bar for opportunistic in-process authoring, explicitly NOT a relaxation of cold-start. Expose the profile-selection signal that reuses the existing shouldRunRecipeEvidenceGate logic (session or dimensionId present means cold-start, otherwise opportunistic) so the host can resolve and pass the profile. Acceptance on node 22: Core build and build:check green; a NEW profile test asserts cold-start equals the current full behavior on the byte-identical corpus (zero change) and opportunistic drops ONLY the 3-file floor and session-scope while keeping content and grounding; the existing P1 golden-corpus, stage-3 byte-identical, drift, and matrix tests stay green because cold-start is the default; full Core test green. The 3 pre-existing lint:naming files are the out-of-scope carve-out — do not touch or rename them; use build:check plus test plus drift as the green bar. Gates not relaxed (cold-start byte-identical; opportunistic is a declared profile not a backdoor); main only, no push or tag or version bump; FieldSpec unchanged; the dead recipe-evidence-gate duplicate is out of scope. Producer-consumer: this ships the profile axis on @alembic/core/knowledge for the P1.4b in-process re-point (AlembicAgent plus main-body GatewayActionRegistry) which follows as a separate wave with producer-prompt-first discipline. Backfill the Core commit, the cold-start-byte-identical proof (existing P1 tests still green), the opportunistic-profile test result, and raw build and test output.
